mil7.5.4:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, vicchikassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban-ti yaṃ vadesi, kataman-taṃ ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban-ti. - Yathā mahārāja vicchiko nangulāvudho, nangulaṃ ussāpetvā carati, evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena ñāṇāvudhena bhavitabbaṃ, ñāṇaṃ ussāpetvā viharitabbaṃ. Idaṃ mahārāja vicchikassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ. Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja therena Upasenena Vangantaputtena:
mil7.5.4:2.1: Ñāṇakhaggaṃ gahetvāna viharanto vipassako parimuccati sabbhayā, duppasaho ca so bhave ti.
